command:
set -euo pipefail
D=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-mcp-deploy.XXXXXX)
cd "$D"
gh repo clone gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity repo -- --quiet
cd repo
git fetch -q origin main
git checkout -q --detach 12fa3b4d0c8c73dcf8a205d8b282a30beebfafc0
ACTUAL=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
[ "$ACTUAL" = "12fa3b4d0c8c73dcf8a205d8b282a30beebfafc0" ]
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_chatgpt_mcp.py
bash tools/install_omega_chatgpt_mcp_ai_core.sh
printf '\nDEPLOYED_MAIN=%s\n' "$ACTUAL"
systemctl --user show omega-chatgpt-mcp.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID --no-pager
